summary: Iteration 16: Complete testing of Notification System (Push+Email), FloatingChatBubble (multiple chats), Marketplace PIUP Integration, NotificationSettingsPage. Backend: 15/15 tests PASSED. Frontend: All components working correctly.

integration_issues.issue: Auth session may not persist across Playwright page.goto() - works correctly with in-app navigation via settings icon

critical_code_review_comments: notifications.py (347 lines): Well-structured notification system with 11 notification types, push+email preferences, recent notifications, unread count, mark read functionality
FloatingChatBubble.jsx (603 lines): Complete implementation with ChatWindow, ChatListPopup, NewChatModal, WebSocket integration, minimize/maximize, multiple simultaneous chats (max 3)
NotificationBell.jsx (260 lines): Clean implementation with dropdown, unread count badge (red circle), mark read, settings navigation
NotificationSettingsPage.jsx (267 lines): Full preferences UI with toggle switches for 11 push options and 6 email options, save functionality
MarketplacePage.jsx (599 lines): PIUP integration shows subscriptions (Free/Pro/Business) and 6 PIUP products as featured section before community products
seed_data_creation: Uses existing chat conversations and notification preferences from previous iterations
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features verified working: 1) Notification system with GET /api/notifications/types (11 types), GET/PUT /api/notifications/preferences (push+email), GET /api/notifications/unread-count, GET /api/notifications/recent, POST /api/notifications/mark-read/{id}, POST /api/notifications/mark-all-read. 2) FloatingChatBubble shows in bottom-right, opens chat list popup, supports multiple chat windows (max 3), minimize/maximize, WebSocket for real-time. 3) NotificationBell in feed header shows unread count badge, dropdown with recent notifications, settings gear icon. 4) NotificationSettingsPage has toggle switches for all push and email preferences with save functionality. 5) MarketplacePage shows PIUP subscriptions (Free/Pro/Business) and PIUP products before community products divider.
